method: Actual native-dialog, touch, keyboard and existing-game browser checks. Before-row positions were captured locally before this change.
checks: Phone starters show the complete first game row at 390px and 320px; one-copy filters stay in a closed native sheet until requested
Touch selections immediately update genre/sort/availability and honest result counts; Apply closes, and Reset preserves the current search and collection
Keyboard opens the native modal, Tab/ShiftTab stay inside, Slash cannot escape, and Escape/Close restore visible opener focus
Removing main-page filter chips focuses the visible filter opener; clearing the search still focuses the search field
Widening closes and restores the original single controls with focused Sort and selected values; shrinking closes the sheet and focuses its visible opener
Filtered cards save and launch the existing Orbit game; Back/Forward preserves the collection and closes the filter sheet before reopening a player
The Google Sites/landscape sheet scrolls to usable 44px controls, honors reduced motion, and has no horizontal overflow or parent JavaScript errors
